cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, sys
# big ambiguity class: 4 concrete routes, one signature
obj={"version":1,"n":7,"capacity":[2,2,2,2,2,2,2],
  "edges":[{"u":0,"v":1,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"x"},
           {"u":0,"v":2,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"x"},
           {"u":1,"v":3,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"x"},
           {"u":2,"v":3,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"x"},
           {"u":3,"v":4,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"x"},
           {"u":3,"v":5,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"x"},
           {"u":4,"v":6,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"x"},
           {"u":5,"v":6,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"x"}],
  "rounds":[{"launch_us":0,"timeout_us":40,"host_delay_us":1,"drop_host_ack":False,"drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]}]}
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","submission/main.py"],input=json.dumps(obj).encode(),capture_output=True)
o=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
print("classes:", json.dumps(o["classes"]))
print("summary:", json.dumps(o["summary"]))
assert o["summary"]=={"topology_paths":4,"observable_classes":1,"observed_classes":1,
  "unique_observed_classes":0,"ambiguous_observed_classes":1,"path_evidence_lower":1,
  "path_evidence_upper":4,"coverage_status":"complete"}, o["summary"]
assert o["classes"][0]["candidate_count"]==4 and len(o["classes"][0]["candidate_witnesses"])==2
w=o["classes"][0]["candidate_witnesses"]
assert w[0]!=w[1] and all(len(x)==3 for x in w)
# partial proof -> still same signature observed if any certified path exists
obj2=json.loads(json.dumps(obj)); obj2["rounds"][0]["drop_ping"]=[0]
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","submission/main.py"],input=json.dumps(obj2).encode(),capture_output=True)
o2=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
print("with drop_ping [0]:", json.dumps(o2["rounds"]), json.dumps(o2["summary"]))
print("OK")
PYEOF
